hook: ChatGPT gave me a 9-step plan when I asked how to handle a difficult conversation with my boss.
caption:
ChatGPT gave me a 9-step plan when I asked how to handle a difficult conversation with my boss.

I needed three sentences.

This is the thing nobody talks about with AI: it doesn't know if you're a "give me the full framework" person or a "just tell me what to say" person.

So it guesses. And it almost always guesses wrong for you specifically.

Some people open ChatGPT and want the dissertation. Others want the tweet. Some need bullet points or their brain bounces off the wall. Others need it to sound like a real human wrote it or they won't use it.

The AI isn't broken. It just doesn't know you.

That's the whole problem bootfile.ai exists to solve. Your BootFile is essentially a cheat code you hand the AI before every conversation — here's how I think, here's what overwhelms me, here's what format I'll actually use.

Stop editing AI outputs into something usable.

Start getting outputs that already are.

Drop a 🙋 below if you've ever gotten a 9-step plan when you needed three sentences.
